review: Multicrack Heathcliff is quite the crackhead ID. So let’s start off with his skills! - Skill 1, 40S-2 Activation – 2 Coin Skill, Base Roll – 11, Conditionals Met – 13. - Skill 2, Photoelectric Mark – 3 Coin Skill, Base Roll – 13, Conditionals Met – 19. Inflicts Defense Level and HP Healing Down. Can Inflict "Photoelectricity". This skill costs 10 Charge Count to use, if you're below it, it'll cost some health to use it instead. - Skill 3, Photoelectric Harpoon – 4 Coin Skill, Base Roll – 13, Conditionals Met – 21. (Although you will rarely see his S3 roll 21, as it requires 4 Charge Potency). Can Inflict "Photoelectricity". He also gains 1 Clash Power at 3+ Charge Potency. His S3 is massive help in gaining him Charges, similar to Multicrack Faust, allowing him to gain at least 10 Charges. This skill can also inflict Blunt Fragility for every 2 Charge Potency he has.
